title: 摩根大通与Visa警示第三方供应商网络攻击风险
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Vulnerabilities have absolutely been dominating the news cycles recently and let me give you some quick stats about a decade ago There was around 7,000 vulnerabilities in cyber security in one year back in 2016 last year
segments.zh: 漏洞问题近期绝对占据了新闻头条，让我给你一些快速数据：大约十年前，网络安全领域一年约有7000个漏洞；2016年，去年……

segments.en: We crossed 48,000 vulnerabilities in just one year This year as of this morning we crossed 102,000 publicly disclosed vulnerabilities in just year-to-date
segments.zh: 我们一年内就突破了48000个漏洞。今年截至今天早上，年初至今公开披露的漏洞已超过102000个。

segments.en: So is AI fueling this? Yes, it is absolutely a part of it What are we facing from a technology standpoint a financial industry standpoint?
segments.zh: 那么AI在助推吗？是的，绝对是部分原因。从技术和金融行业角度看，我们面临什么？

segments.en: We're facing an onslaught of vulnerabilities being discovered and actioned quicker than ever before 5-10 years ago, it was a human capital type issue
segments.zh: 我们面临大量漏洞被更快发现和利用。5-10年前，这是人力资本型问题。

segments.en: Humans would find it humans would exploit it hence organized crime groups nation states insider threats What are we facing right now?
segments.zh: 人类发现、人类利用，因此有组织犯罪集团、国家行为体、内部威胁。我们现在面临什么？

segments.en: AI assisted exploitation discovery at a scale where you don't need to sleep right you're relying on Automations you're relying on artificial intelligence super intelligence if you want to follow the political wording scheme
segments.zh: AI辅助的漏洞利用发现达到规模，你不需要睡觉，依赖自动化、人工智能、超级智能——如果你想用政治措辞的话。

segments.en: And that is what's fueling this issue One caveat I'd give you to your question I think we need to be also cautious as an industry not every attack not every outage is related
segments.zh: 这就是推动问题的因素。对你的问题我有一个提醒：作为行业，我们需要谨慎，并非每次攻击、每次中断都相关。

segments.en: There are absolutely things happening even JP Morgan Chase is a good example recently And I know they've been in the news cycles. They had a software bug. They publicly disclose that and then less than 24 hours later
segments.zh: 确实有些事情在发生，摩根大通就是个好例子。我知道他们最近上了新闻。他们有一个软件缺陷，公开披露后不到24小时……

segments.en: They and other financial institutions. I believe visa mastercard. They disclosed a third-party vendor had an issue
segments.zh: 他们和其他金融机构，我相信是Visa、万事达卡，披露了一个第三方供应商有问题。
